text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I never thought Ramonu-san would 
actually run here! 
Impressive that she agreed to it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, Dober must have put in a tremendous 
effort~. 
Ah, they have arrived~."

text_block_list.name: Girl with Dreadlocks
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh yeah, some Mejiro horse girls are 
participating today, right? 
Huh, those two..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Many Rings
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... isn't that Mejiro Ramonu?! For 
real?! 
Wait, she's running?! With us? That 
legend?!"

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa... She's got some serious aura...! 
She's even wearing her racing silks... but 
can a high-class lady really make the cut 
out here?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"(Just Ramonu-san showing up drew this 
much attention... 
Just as I thought, we can get people 
interested with our running...!)"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Dober. That is not enough. 
Only absolute fervor can truly captivate 
the heart."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(That's it... Simply running isn't enough 
to ignite true passion. 
It's because it's a serious clash—that 
everyone gets fired up!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My legs are shaking... But... I'll put 
everything I have into this!! 
I'll captivate everyone with the Mejiro 
way of running!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. Fan the flames of your 
passion! 
If you desire it, then seize it for 
yourself!
(Whoaaaaaah! Waaaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...! The crowd is going wild! 
Dober's plan worked!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This frenzy is reminiscent of a 
Twinkle Series race— 
......!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Lady Palmer!! 
We should use this very race in our 
presentation to the Mejiro family—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dober, you're amazing, absolutely amazing! 
To be able to run like that against 
Ramonu-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bright's handing out flyers too... 
She's working so hard! 
Everything seems to be going smoothly... 
Yeah, nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...I should be happy. 
So why do I feel like this...? Is it 
because she didn't rely on me...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Feeling a little lonely... really...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—And so, as a result of announcing it on 
social media, 
applications from first-time fans have 
already reached 250% compared to last 
year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
That is wonderful. Gaining new fans is 
everything we could hope for. 
...However, that only amplifies the 
concern brought up last time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
If welcoming new fans ends up 
disappointing our long-time supporters, 
we would be putting the cart before the 
horse. Have you reconsidered this point?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First, please take a look at this. 
It's footage from when they entered a 
freestyle race to attract new fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
From the Mejiro family, Lady Ramonu and 
Dober took part~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text:
A freestyle race...!? Entering an amateur 
race 
tarnishes the dignity of the Mejiro name!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's not true...!

—Oh my. Are you saying you doubt *my* 
love?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text: R-Ramonu!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I embraced the race passionately and 
exchanged fervent love with it. 
—Are you implying that was mere child's 
play?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Besides, isn't it the Mejiro way for an 
Umamusume to face any race 
with utter sincerity, regardless of where 
it takes place?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text:
...N-No... but still, 
people with different values coming to 
understand one another is a pipedream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: They claim it's a pipedream, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, we can understand each other... 
Because that's exactly what happened...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You will understand once you see it. 
—The footage, that is.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In today's main race, two Umamusume from 
the prestigious Mejiro family 
are running! Just what kind of performance 
will they show us... It's almost time for 
the start!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Many Rings
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sprint out front and take full 
control of the pace! 
Raaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Dreadlocks
text_block_list.text:
A runaway escape right out of the gate! No 
way anyone can keep up with that pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Did you really think I'd let you take it? 
Heh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The leader passes the first corner at a 
blistering pace. A little further back in 
the pack, 
Ramonu is steadily moving up through the 
field!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text:
!! ...All right. ...Good, good— 
Yes, keep it going...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Guh... haah, haah... Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Seriously?! She's 
catching up to that monster runaway lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu surges into the lead in one fell 
swoop, pulling away from the chasers! 
However, Dober is closing in with a fierce 
late charge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text: Go... Go, Ramonu!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive B
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Dober! 
Stay on Ramonu's tail...!! Come on, right 
there!!

text_block_list.name: Dober & Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaah! 
Ah...! —Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Will it be Ramonu, or will it be Dober?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators on Site & in Conference Room
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaah! Waaaaaaaah!! 
Oooooooh! Waaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive B
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oh dear. I got carried away... 
Regardless, both Ramonu and Dober ran 
magnificent races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* ...When it comes to races, one 
simply cannot help getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right?! The spectators at the 
freestyle race 
were just as thrilled as all of you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Captivated by the same race, feeling the 
exact same excitement. If they can share 
that, 
then surely they can get along and enjoy 
it together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Honoring history and forging a new 
one—these two things are not 
mutually exclusive. They can blend 
together beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Interaction between our long-time fans and 
newcomers will surely 
bring a fresh breeze into the Mejiro 
household.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even if things feel a bit awkward on the 
day of the event, 
we'll liven things up and make sure 
everyone has a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
I see... The Umamusume themselves can 
provide support if needed. 
...Does anyone else have any opinions on 
the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Executive A
text_block_list.text:
—No. All concerns have been completely 
resolved. There should be no problem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Elder
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, the proposal is officially 
approved. 
We're counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Yes!! Leave it to us!" 
"Yes. You can count on us~."
